summary: Iteration 9 voucher PDF: 9/9 backend pytest tests PASS and all frontend flows verified. Public GET /api/vouchers/{code}/pdf?k=... returns 403 while pending, 404 on wrong token, 422 on token <8 chars, and 200 application/pdf (>3KB, body starts with %PDF, Content-Disposition contains bon-cadeau-{code}.pdf) after admin PATCHes status=paid. Case-insensitive code accepted. Admin GET /api/admin/vouchers/{id}/pdf works while pending (200 PDF), returns 401 without token and 404 on unknown id. POST /api/vouchers returns a download_token of length >=16. Backend log confirms 'Voucher email sent' for delivered@resend.dev. build_voucher_email HTML contains the PDF link and the word 'PDF'. Frontend admin /admin/vouchers: voucher-pdf-{id} buttons present; clicking triggered a real browser download with filename bon-cadeau-CFC-5PGQ-MN2L.pdf. Landing /?code=CFC-TEST-1234 auto-opens booking modal after intro with booking-input-voucher='CFC-TEST-1234' and booking-voucher-status='Code introuvable'; /?code=CFC-P9DY-W36C shows 'Bon cadeau valide — 280 € déduits'. Regression: hero-cta-book-button still opens modal with empty voucher input.
